name: The Royal Heir
source:
Now that you and your true love have found your happily ever after... what comes next? Head back to Cordonia in this follow-up to The Royal Romance!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Royal_Heir]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
如今，你与真爱终于迎来了幸福美满的结局…接下来又会发生什么？在《王室恋爱法则》的这部续作中，重返科尔多尼亚吧！
